note: Suggested thresholds for the founder (founderReview.md B3), revised 27 Oct 2026 after the 2020 crash replay. Nothing is paused until the owner sets a policy: npm run protections -- set docs/policies/protections-suggested.json --reason "...". Losses are the fall in each bot's value (open positions included) as a share of its budget, over rolling calendar days, daily and weekly only. The earlier set (realised losses, 2% a day, 5% a week, 8% a month, a 1-day pause after 2 losing exits) tripped on the planned April 2020 rebalance and kept the bot out of the rebound: -15.0% against -6.7% with these and -7.5% with none. Pauses hold new buys only and lift by themselves.
